free_tier.stated: Start for FREE; FREE Trial; 2-day free trial

egress.terms: No byte allowance is published for the trial; the paid plan is EUR 17 per month with rules priced by count; ingress: tcp+udp

interface_detail: Portal at portal.gcore.com; the product onboards from an IP and port.
tooling: portal configuration of a proxy rule, no agent
chaining: Fronts a public origin by IP and port; with a free VM as the origin it would give that VM a UDP port for two days, then cost EUR 17/month.

limits.value: proxy rules are priced in bands: 2-5 rules EUR 10/mo, 6-10 EUR 8/mo each, 11+ EUR 6/mo each

binding_note: The constraint that fails first is the trial length, which the vocabulary has no kind for. At 1 TiB/month the billable unit is the rule count and the monthly fee, not a byte allowance.

identity_cost.detail: A Gcore account at auth.gcore.com. The trial is 2 days and the paid plan follows on the same account; the signup form was not opened.

reliability_note: Trial expires in 2 days; the paid plan bills per proxy rule band.
confidence_note: The 2-day trial and the EUR 17 plan are on the product page read. The trial's byte allowance and its egress billing are not published there and would need the portal.

evidence.proved: Edge Proxy is volumetric-protected Layer 4 ingress for TCP and UDP services, filtering at the edge and forwarding clean traffic to an origin
The offer is 'FREE Trial' and '2-day free trial'; the PAYG price is EUR 17 per month with flood traffic not billed

price_per_tb_month: EUR 17 per month after the trial
notes: The only provider that sells exactly what Cloudflare Spectrum sells, arbitrary TCP and UDP on a chosen port, and the only one whose free window is measured in days. Included as the price reference point: EUR 17/month is what this class costs when it is not free.

extras.wg_detail: Edge Proxy is L4 ingress for TCP and UDP to an origin, so a WireGuard listener would be reachable through it; but the free window is a 2-day trial.
extras.volume_stated: No byte allowance is published for the trial; the paid plan is EUR 17 per month with rules priced by count
extras.transit_note: Gcore's edge filters and forwards the traffic
